Optimizer state and triple

Source: R/example_optimizers.R
optimizers_state.Rd

optimizers_OptimizerState ports the OptimizerState named tuple: a pytree node with one child (packed_state, the list of flattened per parameter states) and the parameter treedef and per parameter state treedefs as auxiliary data. optimizers_Optimizer ports the Optimizer named tuple list(init_fn, update_fn, params_fn). optimizers_optimizer ports the decorator that turns a constructor of single array optimizer functions into one that works on pytrees of parameters (nested lists of arrays).

Usage

optimizers_OptimizerState(packed_state, tree_def, subtree_defs)

optimizers_Optimizer(init_fn, update_fn, params_fn)

optimizers_optimizer(opt_maker)

Arguments

packed_state

List of flattened per parameter states.

tree_def

Treedef of the parameters.

subtree_defs

List of treedefs of the per parameter states.

init_fn, update_fn, params_fn

The optimizer functions: init_fn(params), update_fn(step, grads, opt_state) and params_fn(opt_state) (the get_params function).

opt_maker

A function returning list(init, update, get_params) that work on single arrays: init(x0) returns a state pytree, update(i, g, state) the new state and get_params(state) the array.

Value

optimizers_OptimizerState() an object of class OptimizerState, optimizers_Optimizer() a named list and optimizers_optimizer() an optimizer constructor.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
my_sgd <- optimizers_optimizer(function(step_size) {
  list(function(x0) x0, function(i, g, x) x - step_size * g, function(x) x)
})
opt <- my_sgd(0.1)
state <- opt$init_fn(list(w = jnp_ones(2)))
} # }
